g.text: There is no name catalog yet, so the sounds show as numbers.
Scanning reads the User bank's 128 names back from the unit. That
is the only bank this instrument will dump: General MIDI and the
three preset banks are ROM, and the protocol has no request for
them. Their names come from a printed catalog transcribed
separately -- there is nothing on the unit to ask.
The read is silent: nothing is selected, nothing plays, and
nothing is written to the instrument. It asks for one program at a
time, so it takes a moment.
· front panel and MIDI · ROM, from the catalog
no names yet -- press r to read the User bank
